entities.summary: Tony Simon, better known by his stage name Blockhead, is an American hip-hop record producer and DJ from Manhattan, New York. Aside from his solo efforts released on the Ninja Tune label, he is most associated with producing tracks for Aesop Rock. He has been a member of the groups such as Party Fun Action Committee and The Mighty Jones. Blockhead was a composers & musicians from Manhattan (b. 2000, Manhattan). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
